stem.en: A shoe company is planning its next shoes. Match each plan to the group of buyers it is made for.

label.en: Everyone, for daily use at low cost

text.en: Rubber soles, a light build, extra grip and ankle support
Polished leather, a formal look, comfortable all day, a higher price
A simple design that lasts a full school year and does not cost much
Soft slippers for comfort on daily errands, kept cheap
Strong stitching that children cannot scuff easily on the way to class
A sole that bends and cloth that breathes, for long training sessions

explanation.en: 'For whom to produce' shapes every feature. Students need strong shoes at a low price. Office workers want a formal leather look. Players need grip and a light build. Slippers for daily use must be comfortable and cheap. One factory answers 'for whom' in four different ways.

hints.en: Ask what each group of buyers can pay, and what their day asks of the shoe.
